empty.noBooksHint: This account has no book assigned yet. Create one in the Schreibwerkstatt web app, or ask your administrator for access.
settings.general.serverHint: Switching servers signs you out — the device token is valid for one server only. Local content is kept; sign in again on the new server afterwards.
settings.general.favoriteBookHint: The favorite book opens at launch and drives the page picker. You can also switch it any time from the toolbar.
settings.general.switchServerAlertMessag: You'll be signed out and need to sign in again on the new server. Local content that hasn't synced yet is kept.
settings.language.label: App language
settings.language.hint: Language of the app interface. Without an explicit choice it follows your server profile; “Automatic” follows the system language (German or English). The change takes effect immediately.
settings.appearance.hint: “Automatic” follows the system; Light/Dark forces the look for shell and editor.
settings.appearance.focusHint: Controls how strongly the editor dims the surroundings of the active paragraph. The change takes effect immediately in the open editor.
settings.typo.measureHint: Limits line length (in characters) for more comfortable reading. “ch” ≈ the width of one digit.
settings.typo.paperHint: “System” follows Light/Dark. Other tones force a fixed writing surface (e.g. Sepia for warm light).
settings.typo.dimHint: In focus mode the editor dims the inactive paragraphs. “Off” uses the editor default (theme-correct); when on, you set the strength yourself.
settings.typo.resetAlertMessage: Font size, line height, column width, font family, paper tone and focus dimming are reset to their defaults. Your texts are kept.
settings.writing.showStats: Show word count & reading time in the toolbar
settings.writing.pickerMetricHint: Length of each page in the list (⌘O). Counted from the locally mirrored text — pages never loaded show “—”. The total for all matches sits at the bottom of the picker.
settings.writing.goalHint: Shows a progress bar in the toolbar until the open page reaches the goal. The app is designed for exactly one page — so the goal applies per page.
settings.writing.autosaveHint: Wait time after the last keystroke before the draft is saved. Takes effect the next time the editor opens. Local saving still always happens first (no data loss).
settings.writing.synonymHint: Suggests synonyms for a selected word — from the thesaurus (German only) and via AI. Runs online through the server; hidden silently when offline.
settings.sync.cadenceHint: How often the active window checks for changes. “Relaxed” saves battery/data; “Manual only” syncs solely on demand.
settings.sync.pauseHint: Holds automatic syncing until you turn it back on or restart the app. Local changes stay queued.
sync.conflict.serverGone: Page no longer exists on the server — your local version is kept.
conflict.subtitle.generic: The server version changed while you were working offline.
conflict.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the server version (offline?). Please try again later.
settings.spell.deviceHint: Checking runs via LanguageTool on the server (online only). This switch can additionally turn it off per device — even when it's enabled on the server.
settings.spell.languageHint: “Automatic” lets the server choose the language (from the book language, usually Swiss German). A fixed choice overrides that per device.
settings.spell.serverNote: Strictness (picky) and active rules are managed on the server and can't be changed here.
spell.extensionConflict.title: LanguageTool browser extension detected
settings.account.signOutHint: Signing out only removes the device token from the keychain. Local content that hasn't synced yet is kept.
settings.account.appUpdateHint: The app checks for new versions automatically in the background and installs them after your confirmation. This button triggers an immediate check.
settings.account.appUpdateHintStore: Updates for this app arrive through the App Store.
settings.account.updateHint: A newer editor bundle is downloaded and takes effect at next launch (no switch mid-writing).
settings.account.clearCacheHint: Reloads the editor assets fresh from the server. Affects only the editor — your texts (local mirror) stay untouched.
settings.account.signOutAlertMessage: You'll need to sign in again with a device token afterwards. Local content is kept.
settings.account.clearCacheAlertMessage: The editor is reloaded from the server. Without a connection it won't be available until the next successful download. Your texts are kept.
settings.account.resetMirrorHint: Deletes all local content (pages, outbox, sync state) and rebuilds the mirror fresh from the server. Useful for sync issues. Unsynced changes will be lost.
settings.account.resetMirrorAlertMessage: All local content will be deleted and rebuilt fresh from the server. Unsynced changes will be lost. The editor cache is kept.
settings.account.deleteHint: Deletes your Schreibwerkstatt account on {server} with all its content — and removes the local mirror from this Mac. This cannot be undone.
settings.account.deleteSheetBody: This deletes your account, your books and pages, writing times and all device tokens. Books others shared with you remain theirs.
settings.account.deleteSheetLocalNote: On this Mac the local text mirror, the sync state and your sign-in are removed afterwards. Changes that haven't synced yet are gone as well.
settings.account.deleteDoneBody: Your account was deleted and you have been signed out. The local data of this server was removed from this Mac.
settings.account.deleteDoneScheduled: The data will be erased for good on {date}.
settings.account.deleteUnsupportedBody: This server doesn't support deleting your account from the app yet. You can do it in your browser from your profile.
settings.account.deleteForbidden: This account cannot be deleted from the app. Please contact the operator of the server.
settings.account.deleteUnauthorized: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again and retry.
settings.account.deleteFailedGeneric: Deleting failed. Your data is unchanged.

toolbar.synonymsHelp: Synonyms for the word at the cursor (⌘⇧S)
toolbar.normalizeQuotesHelp: Normalize quotation marks to the book style (de-CH «», de-DE „“)
toolbar.lektoratHelp: Start the server-side copy-edit for this page (saves and uploads the page first)

toolbar.tip.noGoal: Characters of the open page · {today} · ~{min} min reading time
toolbar.tip.serverUnreachable: Server unreachable — local changes are saved safely and will sync once the server responds again
toolbar.tip.pending.one: {n} page waiting to upload — saved safely on this device
toolbar.tip.pending.other: {n} pages waiting to upload — saved safely on this device
toolbar.tip.syncError: Last sync failed — local changes are saved safely. {msg}
save.tip.dirty: Unsaved change — saved locally on its own in a moment
lektorat.err.generic: The server could not complete the copy-edit.
lektorat.err.forbidden: No copy-editing permission for this book.
lektorat.err.notFound: Page or book not found on the server.
lektorat.err.offline: Server unreachable — the copy-edit needs a connection.
lektorat.err.timeout: The copy-edit job stopped responding (timed out).
login.tokenHint: Create the token in Schreibwerkstatt under “My account → Device token” and paste it here. It's shown only once.
login.subtitle: Sign in to sync your pages.
login.requiresServer: This app is a companion to Schreibwerkstatt: it works only with a Schreibwerkstatt server and an account on it — there's no standalone mode without a server.
login.heroTagline: Distraction-free writing — one page, fully offline-capable. Your pages sync with Schreibwerkstatt.
login.step1: Create an account on schreibwerkstatt.app or sign in.
login.step2: Issue a token under “My account → Device token” — it's shown only once.
login.step3: Paste the token below and click “Sign in”.
login.demoNote: Signs you in to a public test account on {host} — no account of your own, no token needed. Its contents are visible to all demo users and are reset regularly: don't write anything there you want to keep.
login.privacyBody: Your texts are stored locally on this Mac first and synced only with the Schreibwerkstatt server you choose. The device token lives solely in the macOS keychain — never in settings, logs, or the editor. No data is sent to third parties; the app talks only to your server.
picker.loadErrorHint: Check the server connection and try again.
picker.noPagesHint: Create a page on the web, or pick another book.
picker.noBookHint: Choose a book in the toolbar on the left.
picker.unsavedHint: Changed locally, not on the server yet
about.body: Native macOS shell (SwiftUI/AppKit + WKWebView) for exactly one page, fully offline-capable. The editor itself is loaded over the air from the Schreibwerkstatt server — no fork, no clutter. The app is a companion to Schreibwerkstatt and can't be used without its server (account, editor bundle, sync).
auth.err.malformedToken: Invalid token format. Expected “swd_…” from your account area.
auth.err.unauthorized: Token invalid or revoked. Please issue a new device token in Schreibwerkstatt.
picker.a11y.searchHint: Typing filters the pages; arrow keys select, return opens.
picker.a11y.openHint: Opens the page in the editor
picker.a11y.noStats: Length unknown, text not local yet

export.missingPage: (This page has never been loaded on this device — no text available.)

settings.account.diagnosticsHint: Puts a status report plus this session's most recent log lines on the clipboard — useful for support requests. Contains no token and no text from the manuscript.
